about: John A. Schifino is an attorney providing legal services covering Business Litigation, Employment & Labor: Employer and Appellate.

John Schifino, who practices law in Tampa, Florida, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2010 - 2011, 2013, 2015 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at Lewis & Clark Law School. He graduated in 1994. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 1994.
